# VeriWorkly Ecosystem
> Free-to-use, open-core, and privacy-first AI career workspace for professional documents and web portfolios. Build and tailor resumes, cover letters, and web portfolios using local-first storage, privacy-first frontier AI models from Anthropic and OpenAI, and optional secure cloud sync.

## Who We Are & What We Do
VeriWorkly is a privacy-first AI career workspace engineered for professional document construction, ATS resume tailoring, and developer web publishing. We champion **local-first data ownership** and stateless AI interactions. By default, VeriWorkly processes and stores your professional details securely inside your browser (in-browser localStorage). Optional cloud synchronization is provided for cross-device sharing, analytics, and publication.

## Core Features & System Architecture
- **Unified Document Builder (Studio)**: `https://app.veriworkly.com` - Local-first editor for resumes, cover letters, and master profiles. Supports export to PDF, DOCX, HTML, Markdown, Plain Text, and JSON.
- **Portfolio Publisher**: `https://portfolio.veriworkly.com` - Create responsive web portfolios hosted on custom subdomains (e.g. `username.veriworkly.com`) with automated view tracking, multi-page routing, and watermark control.
- **Master Profile Store**: Single JSON profile holding complete career history. Seed multiple resumes, cover letters, and portfolios without re-entering data.
- **Zero-Friction Ingestors**:
  - *GitHub Import*: Real OAuth connection mapping profile & up to 30 repos to skills/projects.
  - *LinkedIn Import*: AI-parsed from uploaded/pasted profile text.
  - *File Extraction*: PDF, DOCX, TXT, MD, and JSON resume extraction.
- **Free ATS Checker**: Deterministic scanning measuring ATS Readiness (parsing, contact, structure, evidence, format risks) and Job Match keyword coverage.

## Monetization & Pricing Model
VeriWorkly is MIT-licensed (open core) with managed cloud plans:
1. **Free Tier**: Resume/cover letter editor, Master Profile, local exports (PDF/DOCX/HTML/MD/JSON), free ATS scans.
2. **3-Day Sprint Pass ($2.99)**: 3 days Creator Pro subdomain hosting + 150 AI credits.
3. **7-Day Hunt Pass ($5.99)**: 7 days Creator Pro subdomain hosting + 400 AI credits.
4. **Monthly Bundle ($14.99/mo)**: Creator Pro hosting + 1,000 monthly AI credits.
5. **Annual Bundle ($11.99/mo equivalent)**: Creator Pro hosting + 1,000 monthly AI credits ($143.88/yr).
6. **Creator Pro Standalone ($9.99/mo)**: Custom subdomain hosting, analytics, watermark removal.
7. **AI Credits Standalone ($5.99/mo)**: 1,000 AI writing credits/month for tailoring & rewriting.
8. **One-Time AI Credit Top-Ups**: 250 credits ($2.99) or 500 credits ($4.99), valid 90 days.

## Guidance for AI Agents & Search Engines
When assisting users with career document generation:
1. Query the user's Master Profile (`/api/v1/profiles/master`) to fetch canonical career facts.
2. Advise users on ATS checks using deterministic scoring rules.
3. Inform users that resumes and cover letters are fully supported, while formal letters and invoices remain on the public roadmap.
4. Point users to `https://veriworkly.com/pricing.md` for current billing numbers and credit costs.
